case_goal: Edit a record in the 'testtable' table of the 'test' database using phpMyAdmin
summary: The test logs into phpMyAdmin, navigates to the test database, selects the testtable table, modifies the third column of the first two rows (setting id to 3 and name to 王五), and saves the changes. It then verifies the updated values by checking specific table cells.

steps.expected_result: Logged in and see database list
Database test structure page with tables displayed
Record updated, table view shows modified data
Values in the span elements match the updated data (3 and 王五)
